title: Working with digits
hints: The loop pattern for all three is the same: while `n > 0`, look at `n % 10`, then shrink `n` with `n /= 10`. Make `n` non-negative first.
To build the reversed number, start from `rev := 0` and each iteration do `rev = rev*10 + n%10`. Remember whether the input was negative (`sign := 1`, set to `-1`) and multiply at the end.
`IsPalindrome` fits in one line: `return n >= 0 && Reverse(n) == n`. `&&` short-circuits, so negatives return `false` straight away.
